direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has ended her father's phone call and turns back with her earlier warmth diminished. Kasun notices the change without knowing what caused it.
direction.people: Kasun stands frame right, facing Anudi off frame left, beside his small food three-wheeler in the right background. He wears a plain faded blue short-sleeved shirt; his empty hands remain below frame, and his friendly ease gives way to quiet concern.

flow.text: Kasun keeps his eyes on Anudi off frame left. His small smile settles and his brow gathers slightly as her changed manner registers.
His eyes dip briefly, giving her space, then return to her eyeline. He presses his closed lips together lightly and releases them without an intrusive gesture.
His brow relaxes while his attention stays with her. He remains facing left, quietly considerate, with his lips closed and hands below frame.
